plugins.applicability: Active CmpHiveListHead walk using the exact _CMHIVE layout. Signature must be 0xBEE0BEE0. The selected name is the first nonempty FileFullPath, FileUserName or HiveRootPath; all three fields stay in the row. A forward list break walks backward once and keeps hives already emitted. dump writes the 4096-byte base block plus the measured stable store. Kernel-canonical pages fall back to the Registry process; user addresses never use the kernel. Unreadable ranges are zero-padded, logged, and fail the task.
gaps: Physical hivescan fallback is not implemented
Reconstructed files have synthetic byte checks and one real SAM smoke read; no byte-for-byte baseline differential
Only one Windows 10 x64 crash dump has a selected-field list differential; 32-bit and damaged-list acceptance remain pending
The upstream FileFullPath column is get_name(); native retains each path field. FileOutput is the literal disabled unless dump is requested
